meta.what: Brief for designing the five App Store slides for Rich & Friends. Combines the brand as it exists in the codebase with the slide copy from app-store-features.json.
meta.why_the_brand_is_here: Without it a design tool invents a pink, a typeface and a corner radius, and the screenshots stop looking like the app they are selling. Every value below is read from src/index.css, tailwind.config.js and public/manifest.webmanifest, not chosen for this file.

companion_files.app-store-features.json: The same five slides, in the exact schema that was asked for. That file is the source of truth for the copy; this one adds how it should look.
companion_files.content.json: All course text, if a slide needs a real sentence from a real lesson.

brand.name: Rich & Friends
brand.tagline_fr: Change de vie. Batis ta liberte financiere.
brand.tagline_en: Change your life. Build your financial freedom.
brand.voice: Direct, warm, second person, no hype. The product argues that slow beats fast, so the copy never promises speed.

logo.note: Blue variants exist for the sea theme. Use pink for the App Store: sun is the default theme.

typeface.note: One typeface everywhere, no second voice on any screen. Poppins is geometric and wide, so display sizes are tracked IN, not out.

accent.name: the pink
accent.rule: This is THE pink and the only one. A wine pink (#D6006B) crept in once through a contrast fix and was removed on sight. Do not darken it to pass a contrast check.

on_accent.note: 3.80:1 on the pink: large text only, 24px and up. Never set body copy in white on pink.

loud.note: 4.30:1. The pink for display sizes when white on pink will not do.

background.name: blush
background.note: The page ground. Also the manifest theme colour.

raised.name: warm rose
raised.note: The soft well inside a card.

radii.rule: Layered: the outer container is rounder than what nests inside it. Matching radii read as flat.

themes.note: Sea is a blue palette with its own tokens. Every App Store slide should use sun.

art_direction.device_frame: iPhone, 390x844 logical pixels, rendered at 2x. That is the width every screen in this app is designed and swept at.
art_direction.background: The blush ground (#FFF5F7), or a soft gradient from blush into white. No photography behind the phone.
art_direction.headline_placement: Above the phone, ink on blush, hero or h1 size. Never white on pink at body size.
art_direction.accent_use: The pink is a spot colour: one button, one bar, one badge per slide. A slide flooded with #FF007A loses the thing it is meant to point at.
do_not: Do not invent a second typeface
Do not darken or tint the pink
Do not put body-size text in white on the pink
Do not show the cycle tracker: it is optional and off by default
Do not claim a number that is not in app-store-features.json

slides.headline: Keep Promises, Together
slides.subheadline: Set a goal, check in daily, and let your friends see it land.
slides.what_to_show: The check-in rail at the top with two or three pink cards still to answer, and two goal cards below it.
bullet_points: A daily check-in rail you swipe, not a form you fill
Prove it with a photo, a link, or a note, whichever fits the goal
Per-goal reminders at the hour you choose, repeating until it is done

slides.headline: Give Every Dollar A Job
slides.subheadline: Envelopes, projects and savings, so the plan and the month agree.
slides.what_to_show: The envelope rings, planned against spent, with one envelope visibly close to its limit.
bullet_points: Envelopes that show planned against actually spent
Projects, savings pots and fixed charges in one place
Connect your bank or type it in, your call

slides.headline: Learn Money, Slowly
slides.subheadline: Four courses that start at zero and end with you investing on your own.
slides.what_to_show: A lesson open, with one financial term underlined inline and its definition showing. That inline explanation is the thing no competitor has.
bullet_points: 52 lessons across 13 modules, each ending on one thing to do
Every financial word explained where you meet it, not in a footnote
Written for Canada, France, the US and the franc zone

slides.headline: Your Day, One Screen
slides.subheadline: Water, mood, classes and deadlines, without opening four apps.
slides.what_to_show: The week strip with the day marks, and the water card under it reading a real amount, for example 17 oz sur 68 oz with the bar a quarter full.
bullet_points: Log water in ml or oz, from your bottle, not in glasses
Your week, your classes and what is due, on one strip
Reminders that tighten when you fall behind and space out when you catch up

slides.headline: Nobody Drops Off Quietly
slides.subheadline: A group that notices when someone goes silent, and says so kindly.
slides.what_to_show: The standing, with one person clearly ahead in pink and the rest in grey. Ties show the number in grey with no equals sign.
bullet_points: A standing that moves the day somebody finishes what they said
One tap to answer a friend asking after you
Say something out loud when a friend does something worth it
